content:
A full-remote freelance/contract position for a Mobile App Engineer specializing in Android with Kotlin. The role involves solving cross-cutting Android challenges and improving architecture for a rapidly growing in-house application. Requires 5+ years of native Android development experience with Kotlin and hands-on experience with Jetpack Compose.

  • Android Native app development experience (5+ years) required
  • Experience with Jetpack Compose declarative UI development required
  • Full-time remote work (40+ hours per week)
  • Opportunity to work on large-scale app architectural improvements
